headline: Micron could dethrone Nvidia and become the biggest driver of S&P 500 profit growth
detail: This is a strong positive signal for the semiconductor sector, especially for Micron. Given your concentration in chips, this news could provide a tailwind for your related holdings like MUU.
rec: Consider adding to your MU position. The scanner shows an ACCUMULATE setup for MU: entry 1081.2-1080.12, stop 1078.27.

headline: Nvidia makes a statement with historic $150 billion buyback announcement
detail: This massive buyback from a sector leader like Nvidia is a huge vote of confidence in the chip industry. It could boost overall sentiment for your tech and chip holdings, including SMH and your leveraged chip ETFs.
rec: No direct trade on this headline alone, but it supports the overall bullish thesis for your chip exposure.

headline: A pullback is brewing, say these strategists who have examined every drawdown since 1956
detail: This is a serious warning about potential market weakness. Given your high concentration in tech/chips and trading on margin, any significant drawdown will be amplified and could hit your book hard.
rec: Review your leveraged positions, especially SOXL and SPAL, which are already in "SELL" status and deep drawdown. Consider trimming to reduce overall portfolio risk.

headline: Treasury yields edge higher amid pressure on global government bonds
detail: Rising Treasury yields typically make growth stocks, like many in your tech/chip portfolio, less attractive as future earnings are discounted more heavily. This could put downward pressure on your holdings.
rec: No direct trade, but this is a macro headwind to monitor closely, especially for your higher-multiple tech names.
